title: GPT-Image-2 in the Wild: A Twitter Dataset of Self-Reported AI-Generated Images from the First Week of Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2604.25370v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The release of GPT-image-2 by OpenAI marks a watershed moment in AI-generated imagery: the boundary between photographic reality and synthetic content has never been more difficult to discern. We introduce the GPT-Image-2 Twitter Dataset, the first published dataset of GPT-image-2 generated images, sourced from publicly available Twitter/X posts in the immediate aftermath of the model's April 21, 2026 release. Leveraging the Twitter API v2 and a multi-stage curation pipeline spanning multilingual text heuristics (English, Japanese, and Chinese), browser-automated Twitter "Made with AI" badge verification, and model name variant matching, we curate 10,217 confirmed GPT-image-2 images from 27,662 collected records over a six-day window. translated_abstract: OpenAI发布的GPT-image-2标志着AI生成图像领域的一个分水岭时刻：摄影现实与合成内容之间的边界从未如此难以分辨。我们推出了GPT-Image-2 Twitter数据集，这是首个公开发布的GPT-image-2生成图像数据集，其数据来源于该模型2026年4月21日发布后立即从公开可用的Twitter/X帖子中收集的内容。利用Twitter API v2以及一个多阶段筛选流程——涵盖多语言文本启发式方法（英语、日语和中文）、浏览器自动化的Twitter“Made with AI”徽章验证以及模型名称变体匹配——我们从六天时间窗口内收集的27,662条记录中精选出10,217张确认的GPT-image-2图像。我们通过四项分析对该数据集进行了特征刻画：基于CLIP的零样本主题分类、OCR文本可读性（82.0%的图像包含可检测文本）、人脸检测（59.2%的图像，共22,583个
tldr: 本文发布了首个公开的GPT-Image-2生成图像Twitter数据集，通过多语言文本启发式、“Made with AI”徽章验证和模型名称匹配等多阶段筛选流程，从模型部署首周收集的27,662条记录中精选出10,217张确认图像，并从主题分类、文本可读性和人脸检测等维度对数据集进行了系统刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first published Twitter dataset of GPT-Image-2 generated images, curating 10,217 confirmed images from 27,662 records collected in the first week of deployment via a multi-stage pipeline combining multilingual text heuristics, "Made with AI" badge verification, and model name matching, with dataset characterization across subject taxonomy, text legibility, and face detection analyses.
